get.summary: List every global (platform administrators) version of a UI label and translation bundles code

post.summary: Create a global (platform administrators) UI label and translation bundles draft
post.description: Creates version 1 of a new code, or the next version of an existing one. The caller is the maker.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.

post.description: Every line is validated; if any line fails, nothing is saved and each rejected line is reported (SDM-012).

parameters.description: A unique key for this operation. A retry with the same key returns the original response.
